newsitem.title: UK: Calderburn gains after newspaper tip.
newsitem.headline: Calderburn gains after newspaper tip.

text.p: Shares in office furniture maker Calderburn Plc rose on Monday after positive comment on the stock in the Mail on Sunday, dealers said.
The stock was up 6p or 11.4 percent at 58-1/2p by 0844 GMT in volume of 22,771 shares.
The paper said a new management team at Calderburn had boosted its profits and wiped out debts, adding that the stock still had upside after doubling in value this year.
With orders growing at its two main divisions and profit margins recovering, the paper said some unnamed investment institutions were building stakes after recent visits to the company.
